A working quantum computer is far more than the ion trap and its real-time control electronics. It depends on a fleet of supporting hardware, including cryogenic compressors, vacuum pumps, power supplies, lasers, temperature controllers, wavemeters and cameras, that has to be kept observable, controllable and reliable. The timing-critical operations such as gate waveforms and ion transport run on dedicated real-time FPGA systems, while this team owns everything that does not need hard timing guarantees. Bring devices onto our current framework, and roll the result out across the fleet without disrupting running experiments.

Raise the standard of the code around you through review, and bring less experienced engineers on by working alongside them.

Backend: Next.js, Node.js, tRPC
